diagnosis: Cyclitic membrane showing reactive epithelial hyperplasia
legend: A macroscopic photo of an aphakic eye with longstanding retinal detachment and formation of a cyclitic membrane forming a fibrous sheet extending from the ciliary body.

A reactive proliferation of the non-pigmented ciliary epithelium forming cords and glandular structures within the fibrous tissue of a cyclitic membrane in an enucleation specimen after failed treatment of retinal detachment.

A multilayered proliferation of cells of the non-pigmented inner layer of the ciliary epithelium flanked by its non-proliferating pigmented outer layer, in an enucleated eye from a 3-year-old child with persistent fetal vasculature (previously called persistent hyperplastic primary vitreous).
